manifest.name: Drawing Pad
manifest.description: Draw over read-only question references and send your working with learner submissions.
surface.title: Drawing pad
settings.inkColorDescription: Six-digit hex color. Recolors all unsent ink when this app theme mode is active.
settings.imageScaleDescription: Export percentage (default 50%). Applied before the fixed 2000 × 2000 pixel cap. Does not change the drawing surface.

settings.colorError: Use a six-digit hex color, for example #facc15.
